name: build_draft_reply
description: Compose the supplier reply from the confirmed findings. Use this rather than writing the reply yourself, so that export-control wording is applied consistently. Pass itar_controlled exactly as the query gave it. For a paid invoice, also pass the transaction ID and transaction details from s4_get_payment_status so the supplier receives them.

query_summary.description: One line describing what the supplier asked, e.g. invoice INV-55678.

root_cause.description: The confirmed finding in plain language.

next_action.description: What happens next or what is needed.

itar_controlled.description: Yes or No, as the query gave it. Omit when it gave none.

transaction_id.description: The payment transaction ID, for a paid invoice.

transaction_details.description: The transaction details exactly as s4_get_payment_status returned them, for a paid invoice.
